description.value: The Surrey Visitor Centre is the official tourism information office for Surrey, BC, operated by Surrey Tourism. Located at 730 176 Street, it serves as a gateway resource for visitors exploring the region. A touring cyclist arriving in Surrey could use it as an orientation stop for local maps, routes, and area highlights.
